verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own marketing claims AI-powered search and chat, including Jira updates (docs-26), and offers Rovo access in the terminal or IDE (docs-5). This points to a first-party natural-language interface, but it is only a one-line claim with no detail on what actions chat can actually perform in Bitbucket. missing for 10: documentation of which repo, PR or pipeline operations can be driven by natural-language commands, depth of chat-driven actions beyond search and Jira updates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
